rules.statement: The doctrine of exceptio rei venditae et traditiae cannot be applied when the transfer is of a share that may be allotted by a partition case, if the transferors are not parties to the case.
rules.supporting_quote: The above doctrine cannot be applied to the transfer in deed No.933 (P2) because Sirisena and Welliya have, by the said deed, transferred the share that may be allotted to them by partition case No.7445/P. But they are not parties to the said case.
